initial_residual.question: Why does the ordering of items affect the number of bins, and how can the heuristic use that information?

contract.task: One-dimensional bin packing: minimize the mean number of bins while placing each item exactly once and respecting bin capacity.
contract.candidate_interface: Define pack(items, capacity), returning a list of nonempty bins; each bin is a list of the original integer item sizes.
contract.score: Mean number of bins on the fixed instances; lower is better.
contract.outcomes: gain, unchanged, or loss relative to the selected parent score
contract.signature: Whether the candidate's packing differs from the parent's on any fixed instance
